verdict.rationale: The only evidence of measured numbers is one community comment pointing to hardware-based latency measurements that put kitty on par with Terminal.app (kitty-comm-20). The remaining performance evidence is anecdotal, such as an activity-monitor impression and reports of slow cat output and slow startup, none of which are published benchmarks. Missing for 10: first-party published benchmark or latency/throughput documentation, reproducible methodology and figures, independent benchmark reports directly cited in the pack, throughput numbers.
